description.zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**路径查看导播台名称。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value that is returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the LIVE console, choose **LIVE Console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** to find the name of the production studio.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.

descriptions.zh:
请先添加节目后再调用本接口查询节目单。使用API添加节目，请参见[添加一个节目到节目单](~~2848051~~)。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Before calling this operation, you must add a show to the playlist. To add a show by calling an API operation, see [Add a show to a playlist](~~2848051~~).

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled. This may affect your business operations. Plan your calls accordingly.
